mapper.select: SELECT C.CODE_ID AS STATUS_CODE, C.CODE_NAME AS STATUS_NAME, NVL(R.CNT, 0) AS CNT FROM COMMON_CODE C LEFT JOIN (SELECT STATUS_CODE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS GROUP BY STATUS_CODE) R ON R.STATUS_CODE = C.CODE_ID WHERE C.CODE_GROUP = 'STATUS' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.CODE_ID

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.TITLE, R.CATEGORY_CODE, R.SERVICE_ADDRESS, R.STATUS_CODE, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, R.USER_NO, CC.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, SC.CODE_NAME AS STATUS_NAME, U.NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME, U.PHONE AS CUSTOMER_PHONE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ESTIMATES E WHERE E.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID) AS ESTIMATE_COUNT, (SELECT MAX(E.FIXER_NO) FROM ESTIMATES E WHERE E.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID AND E.STATUS = 'SELECTED') AS FIXER_NO, (SELECT MAX(F.NAME) FROM ESTIMATES E JOIN USERS F ON F.USER_NO = E.FIXER_NO WHERE E.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID AND E.STATUS = 'SELECTED') AS FIXER_NAME, (SELECT MAX(E.ESTIMATED_PRICE) FROM ESTIMATES E WHERE E.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID AND E.STATUS = 'SELECTED') AS ESTIMATED_PRICE FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = R.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE CC ON CC.CODE_ID = R.CATEGORY_CODE LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_ID = R.STATUS_CODE
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REQUEST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = R.USER_NO
